ActionDescriptions.ToAccessLocalSqlServerSkill:
to connect to local sql server and list databases
Loads the trusted workflow for local SQL Server connectivity and safe read queries via sqlcmd.
ActionDescriptions.ToEnsureLocalSqlServerDatabaseExists:
to create local sql server database if missing
server - SQL Server host (default localhost)
databaseName - database name to ensure exists (letters/numbers/underscore recommended)
ActionDescriptions.ToExecuteSqlQuery:
to run a sql query and return rows json
connectionString - SQL Server connection string. query - read-only SELECT/CTE query. maxRows - maximum rows to return (default 100, max 1000). Returns JSON with columns, rows, and rowCount.
ActionDescriptions.ToListSqlDatabases: to connect to local sql server and list databases\nRuns the local SQL Server listing workflow through ToAccessLocalSqlServerSkill.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunReadOnlySqlQuery:
to run a read only sql query using a secret key
server - SQL Server host name (for example localhost)
database - target database name
username - SQL login user name
secretKey - user-secret key that stores the SQL password (never pass plaintext password)
query - read-only SQL query (SELECT/CTE only)
maxRows - maximum preview rows to return (default 200, max 1000).
ActionDescriptions.ToRunReadOnlySqlQueryToHandleKey:
to run a read only sql query and return a tabular handle key
server - SQL Server host name (for example localhost)
database - target database name
username - SQL login user name
secretKey - user-secret key that stores the SQL password (never pass plaintext password)
query - read-only SQL query (SELECT/CTE only)
maxRows - maximum rows in in-memory tabular payload
Returns opaque handle key only.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunReadOnlySqlQueryToRowsJson:
to run a read only sql query and return in-memory rows json
server - SQL Server host name (for example localhost)
database - target database name
username - SQL login user name
secretKey - user-secret key that stores the SQL password (never pass plaintext password)
query - read-only SQL query (SELECT/CTE only)
maxRows - maximum rows to include in preview payload
ActionDescriptions.ToRunStoredProcedureAsDataTable:
to execute a stored procedure and return a datatable
server - SQL Server host name (for example localhost)
database - target database name
username - SQL login user name
secretKey - user-secret key that stores the SQL password
procedureName - stored procedure name
parametersJson - JSON object of stored procedure parameters. Returns a native DataTable reference.
ActionDescriptions.ToSetupSqlServer2025ExpressSkill:
to install sql server 2025 express with validation and troubleshooting
Loads a proven runbook to install SQL Server 2025 Express on Windows, validate service and login readiness, troubleshoot common failures (including SA password policy and argument issues), and apply post-install hardening.
